item.tib: skyabs mgon bla ma'i dgos sgrub yid bzhin 'dod rgu'i dpal gter gshen bstan mthar rgyas
item.coloph: mdo smad bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog yongs 'dzin chen po shes rab grags pa yis / lha rdzas bcas te gsung nan bskul ba la/ thos bsam cha phra rmongs blun bdag gis yang*/ sman mchog bcud len bsdad pa'i thun gsang la/ mdzad phrin ngo mtshar dpag yas chu gter las/ bum gang tsam zhig rang gi skal pa blangs/ mthar phyin ma grub btang snyoms ngang la lus/ slar yang mkhan chen skyabs rje dam pa dang*/ dge slong rin po che dang grwa slob 'gas/ yang yang bskul ngor ma bcag tsam du ni/ zhig po'i gdung la dal rten rnyed pa yi/ snang btsun nam mkha' blo gros ming thob pa'i/ bstan 'gro'i phyir phan lhag bsam rnam dkar gyi/ 'di bris nyes 'gal gnong 'gyod snying nas bshags//
